meta.title: Lumen · Wallpaper
meta.description: Procedural wallpapers with a rotation scheduler: two generated designs plus four bundled illustrations, changing on an interval, the hour, or daily
section.label: Wallpaper
group.splash.hint: Shown while DSH starts up, then steps aside once the interface is ready
section.wallpaper.hint: Which picture, how often it changes, and whether text stays readable on it
section.composer.hint: The rim and the whale girl on the input box — or switch them off
section.composer.rim: A 2.5px blue rim rings the input box; it brightens on hover and while the box holds focus.
section.composer.mascot: The whale girl hangs on the left edge — click her once to fold her into a tail, again to bring her back.
composer.enable.hint: Off leaves the input box exactly as DSH ships it
composer.off: Off. The input box is back to stock; the wallpaper and splash are untouched.
hero.shake.hint: Same recipe, a fresh set of random values
custom.local.hint: Drop pictures on this row, or use the button — several at once is fine. They are resized and compressed before saving, long edge up to 2560px
custom.url.hint: An image address starting with http:// or https:// — nothing happens until you press apply
splash.local.hint: A picture fills the screen; a clip plays through once. Pick the file first, then choose below where it goes
splash.builtin.note: This plugin ships a built-in splash and uses it by default — press Turn off to disable it, or Choose file… to use your own. A splash is injected when DSH starts, so a full restart is what shows a change
splash.oneAtATime: A splash takes one file at a time
splash.stored: Set as the splash ({kb}KB). A splash is injected when DSH starts, so a full restart of DSH is what will show it
splash.storedBoth: Set as both the wallpaper and the splash ({kb}KB). The wallpaper is live now; the splash shows after a full restart of DSH
splash.wallpaperFailed: The splash is set ({kb}KB), but the wallpaper half did not take. The splash shows after a full restart of DSH
splash.cleared: Splash turned off, and its file removed
splash.switching: Switching back to the built-in splash…
splash.builtinSet: Back to the built-in splash. Restart DSH to see it
splash.builtinSetHad: Back to the built-in splash; the clip you had before has been removed, so using it again means choosing the file again. Restart DSH to see it
splash.unknown: The host route is unavailable, so the splash state cannot be read
splash.off.state: Off — press Built-in to switch it back on
splash.error.noHost: No host route — a splash needs the host's own file
splash.error.unsupported: PNG / JPEG / WebP / GIF / AVIF pictures and MP4 / WebM / OGG clips only
splash.error.tooLarge: That file is too large — the host refused the upload
splash.error.network: The upload did not complete — check the connection and retry
rotation.enable.hint: Walks the playlist automatically, on the schedule set below
rotation.empty: The playlist is empty — add a few wallpapers first
rotation.seeded: Added {n} built-in wallpapers and started rotating. Your previous wallpaper is kept — turn rotation off to get it back
rotation.hourly.hint: A new one at each of these minutes past the hour — pick as many as you like
rotation.session.hint: A new one each time you come back to the DSH window — no fixed time
rotation.order.hint.shuffle: No repeats until every entry has been shown
rotation.order.hint.random: Picked at random — only never the same one twice in a row
rotation.session.noClock: No fixed time — triggered when you return to the window
rotation.missed: Missed {n} while asleep — skipped, caught up once
appearance.opacity.hint: Right shows more wallpaper, left makes the interface easier to read — with the floor below on, text stays legible either way
appearance.raised: Thickened to keep text readable: about {n}% of the wallpaper shows
appearance.autoDim.hint: Busier pictures get a slightly heavier wash so text stands out
appearance.readability.hint: Works out the thinnest wash that still keeps text at WCAG AA contrast
appearance.position.hint: A photo wider than the screen gets cropped — pick which side of it to keep
appearance.tuning.hint: Hue and softness only affect the two generated wallpapers, Drift and Mist — the bundled illustrations ignore them. Grain applies to everything, at half strength on illustrations
status.washBlocked: The interface never became translucent, so it is covering the wallpaper outright. This line appears when the theme channel is unavailable
status.noStorage: localStorage unavailable — nothing will survive a reload
custom.imported: Imported {n} — the first is on screen, the rest are in the playlist
custom.importCapped: Imported {n}; the playlist is full ({cap} limit)
error.notImage: That is not an image file
error.tooLarge: That image is too large (32MB limit)
error.stillTooLarge: Still too large after compression — try another
